statement: Pinned Linux code uses factory stick calibration addresses 0x603d (left) and 0x6046 (right), user calibration magic/data addresses 0x8010/0x8012 (left) and 0x801b/0x801d (right), and shared factory/user IMU regions 0x6020/0x8026. Left/right stick calibration packing is decoded with different ordering.
